decisions.reason: Having already kept this agency-oriented compliance tool once, with multiple variants and some positive feedback, management is likely to defend the sunk investment and treat any weaker uptake as temporary.
As the homepage flagship for the firm’s agency-focused platform direction, it embodies the strongest public commitment and development effort, so withdrawal is very unlikely.

Although newer and less visibly committed than A or B, it fits the firm’s core hosting and security offer, so management is likely to persist and attribute any modest demand to temporary customer upgrade cycles.
